cohort: A total of 12,782 pregnant women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) were identified from 2004 to 2014, categorized by ethnicity (White, African American, Hispanic, and Asian).
finding: Among women with PCOS, African Americans experienced the highest number of increased pregnancy complications, followed by Asians and Hispanics, while Caucasians with PCOS had the lowest risk of pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: African Americans had a higher risk of cesarean sections and lower risk of operative and spontaneous vaginal deliveries, while Asian women had higher odds of operative vaginal delivery, and Caucasians experienced lower risk of cesarean sections and higher odds of spontaneous vaginal delivery.
